gold.user: User wants to create a transcription for a specific call using their Account SID and Call SID. They provide the necessary parameters such as the transcription text and any additional options for the transcription.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response with the details of the created transcription, including the SID of the transcription.

gold.user: User needs to update an existing transcription for a call. They have the transcription SID and want to modify the transcription text or other properties. They send the updated information in the request body.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response confirming the update, along with the updated details of the transcription.
